christmas-pov.template: One continuous vertical smartphone POV shot. {scene} {light} {weather} {guards}
christmas-pov.quality_guards: Keep the viewpoint at a natural human eye height with restrained forward motion and believable near-to-far parallax. Preserve the road, buildings, and decorations throughout the shot. Keep the light strings steady and the snow physically plausible. Use natural phone exposure, soft detail, and readable shadows. No visible camera, car interior, large foreground people, sudden pan, zoom, cut, fade, scene change, text, logo, or watermark.

scene: Drive slowly at windshield height down the center of a quiet snow-packed village lane. Pass stone shopfronts with pine garlands, red bows, and warm windows. A Christmas tree at the far end stays ahead as the nearest storefronts pass to either side.

Drive slowly around a gentle bend on a snowy residential street at windshield height. Pass wooden houses with warm roofline lights and a decorated evergreen at the near corner. Let the curve reveal the next houses gradually.
Walk at an easy pace through a quiet Christmas market aisle at eye height. Pass wooden stalls trimmed with fir branches and warm bulbs. A decorated tree anchors the open square ahead.
Walk slowly down a snow-covered park path at eye height. Pass two small lit fir trees and an iron lamppost. A string of warm lights leads down the path between tall snowy trees.

Drive slowly at windshield height through a small alpine village. Pass timber chalets with warm balcony lights and snow piled along the roadside. A distant church steeple stays centered down the lane.

Drive slowly at windshield height across a short stone bridge toward a decorated village square. Snow rests on the railings, warm light reflects in the narrow creek, and the tree in the square gradually comes closer.
Walk along a quiet brick main street at eye height. Pass shop windows with soft holiday displays, evergreen wreaths, and glowing lamps. Keep the snowy sidewalk open ahead.
Walk up a short snowy lane toward a timber cabin at eye height. Pass a low fence wrapped with warm white lights. A wreath and amber porch light mark the cabin door.
Drive slowly along a narrow snow-lined country road at windshield height. Pass a pine fence and one decorated spruce. A cluster of farmhouse windows glows ahead around a shallow bend.
Walk through a small town square at eye height. Pass a low stone fountain filled with snow as a tall decorated Christmas tree grows larger ahead. Warm windows frame the square.
Walk slowly beneath a single arch of warm holiday lights at eye height. Frosted evergreen branches frame the path and snowy stone houses sit beyond the arch.
Drive slowly at windshield height past a snowy lakeside village. A few warm house windows and lit evergreens sit along the road, with the dark lake visible between the buildings.
light: Deep blue winter twilight with restrained amber window light and detail in the snow.
Quiet winter night under a dark navy sky, with warm practical lights and visible shadow detail.
weather: Sparse small snowflakes drift naturally past the lens.
Fresh settled snow, clear air, and still evergreen branches.
A light snowfall brushes across the road in a gentle crosswind.

reject: camera motion that feels like a drone, a zoom, or a sliding still
architecture, roads, or decorations that warp during the shot
strobing lights, blizzard effects, baked text, fades, or cuts
